public_demo.state: labeled synthetic examples initialized in memory per page; browser reload resets
public_demo.persistence: no API, localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies or IndexedDB; previous private SQLite preserved but not routed
public_demo.privacy: no actual work data; all mutations are local simulations; connect-src none; no third-party trackers

scope: Public hosted example-only in-memory demo. No authentication, API access, persistent storage, live AI or Kakao connection. Offline/local-server builds remain separate regression-tested modes, not the deployed service.
design: Korean practical dashboard, Pretendard, white/neutral/soft muted yellow accent, compact left navigation, central day list, right source/detail panel, >=16px body, no hero or fake analytics, mobile single column. All sample data visibly labeled.
member: {id,name}; plain display names in this single-owner prototype, not authenticated Kakao identities
snapshot: {id,week,createdAt,plans:frozen active plans,members:frozen members,noWork:frozen this week,statuses:frozen derived submission statuses,notice:string}

domain_exports.monday(dateISO): returns Monday of calendar week UTC-date math
domain_exports.planIssues(plan): string[] Korean missing warnings incl !reviewed; time optional
domain_exports.memberStatuses(state,week): [{memberId,name,status: submitted|review|none|missing,count}] status driven by submitterId not assignees
domain_exports.weekChanged(state,week): true if current effective week content differs from latest snapshot; false when none
domain_exports.applyCommand(state,command,context={now:: returns NEW state, throws Error(message Korean) with optional .code; never mutate input. Every nonreplay increments revision. command {type,requestId,expectedRevision,...}; receipts idempotent same payload allowed stale rev replay, changed payload conflict. latest content not historical leakage. 2000 plans/100 members/5000 receipts cap; no unbounded histories.

submit.items: array 1..30 of {date,time,place,task,assignees,notes,reviewed}; date can null, task required. Server builds metadata.

noWork.memberId: member id; cannot if has active submitted plans

finalize.week: Monday; rejects no active plans/noWork or ANY planIssues; allows roster missing but notice explicitly names missing

loadExample.week: Monday; ONLY pristine empty state. 4 labeled sample members, valid/review/noWork/missing examples. no authentic IDs

copyPlans.planIds: 1..30 unique active source week IDs, no existing target copiedFrom record

parser_exports.parseText(text,week): returns {items:[{date,time,place,task,assignees,notes,reviewed:false}],warnings:string[],mode:"rules"}. Conservative line/pipe/day tokenizer; never call network. Supports weekday followed time place task optional 담당 and notes. Ignore header only; preserve unknowns in notes/warnings; do not silently apply edit/cancel. For no-work return items=[] warnings guiding explicit noWork control. Explicit dates outside selected week error. All outputs user review before submit.

export_exports.makeNotice(state,week): Kakao plain text grouped by day; no send; lists missing/none/review; provisional template label
export_exports.makeCsv(state,week): UTF8 BOM CSV, safe Excel formula cells incl whitespace-leading =+-@, quote escape and newline; columns week,date,time,place,task,assignees,submitter,notes,status; active only
export_exports.changeSummary(state,week): Korean change summary vs last snapshot including add/change/cancel, none/missing changes

api.POST /api/commands: command body; returns {state}; 409 stale/changed receipt,422 validation; body max128KiB, Content-Type JSON, strict host localhost/127.0.0.1:[port], same Origin or absent, no CORS
api.static: serve dist with exact asset path; traversal blocked; / redirects SPA; no filesystem exposure

server: createServer({dbPath,staticDir,publicOrigin?}); main env PORT default8788, HOST only127.0.0.1; DATA_DIR ./runtime. Optional PUBLIC_ORIGIN exact HTTPS origin adds one Host, public POST requires same Origin. Never trust X-Forwarded headers. SQLite single-row transaction and receipts. Hosted mode REQUIRES authenticating reverse proxy on every route; Docker uses host networking but application remains loopback-only.
boundary: Public host serves exact static allowlist with GET/HEAD only and connect-src none. Prior SQLite database retained privately and backend stopped. Other services on the same host unchanged.
acceptance: parse preview saves editable real data
offline HTML localStorage fallback warning if storage fails
calendar search and compounded person/place filters
conservative interval conflicts and actual missing-field reminders
guarded static symlink release rollback without reverse-proxy or database writes
month navigation leap/year and per-date drilldown
result-only display does not count past unrecorded plan as completion
build: React19 + direct esbuild bundle; Vite build hung in this environment, removed rather than shipped. Scoped CSS, bundled Pretendard + OFL. No external runtime requests in offline HTML.

retention_limits.on_cap: reject mutation atomically, never silently prune previous records

planning_tools.calendar: Seven dates plus undated section; list/calendar share search, assignee, place, status filters; week change resets search/person/place
planning_tools.checks: Active same-week same-date exact trimmed person/place; two explicit valid HH:mm ranges only yield definite interval overlap. Unknown or coarse times yield advisory check. Shared work is not automatically changed. 200 visible pairs bounded with true total count. No weather/equipment assignment.
planning_tools.reminders: Separate missing/review submitter-driven plain text with user-entered optional deadline. No invented deadline, send or recipient selection.
planning_tools.copy: Selected active plans (1..30) to exactly following week, atomic, source intact, new IDs, reviewed=false, provenance metadata and original source retained; no snapshots/no-work copied, duplicates including cancelled copy rejected.

work_calendar.reference: jiwonmoa date heatmap, observed white radius24 card, Pretendard title20, pill toggles, 7x6 blue tiles; counts not decorative
work_calendar.result: optional plan.result separate from plan approval; status done/partial/not-done; required actual/assessment date<=KST today, summary and recorder; first planSnapshot preserved; recordResult audits before/after; result changes do not mark finalized plan changed
work_calendar.date_semantics: plan date and actual/assessment date separate, same-date combined once; results retained if plan cancelled, unscheduled plans separate; do not auto-complete past tasks
work_calendar.history_fixture: explicit action only, synthetic historical examples; no production or user history imported
work_calendar.filters: query/person/place/status and all/plans/results projections apply to month counts, tiles, detail list, result summary and month CSV
work_calendar.persistence: public demo unchanged: memory-only page state; new results lost on reload; offline and local server modes retain existing storage contracts
